No OCR, crop, replacement image, second critic, peer review, source reconstruction or ambiguity revisit was used. Verified PNG header dimensions after the full viewing stage. Session identity is not observable here and is left null. File hashes and helper exits were not treated as proof of visual inspection.

The peripheral crops and central information island preserve a common scaffold despite their varied edge shapes.

image_material.observation: The exaggerated glossy flecks and crackled-looking grain dominate the timber surface, giving it a heavily processed finish compared with the clearer wood handling in M1.

emotion_control.observation: The visible human interaction is localized in the lower-left inset; enlarged glossy timber, saturated navy and forceful bold type dominate the overall experience. The practical communal warmth is weaker than the handoff in M1 or shared scenes in M3/M4.

residuals: The central white title/date/information panel retains the prohibited passive-template character, with repair action less dominant than object framing.
The final explanatory word is an orphan line; very heavy Latin, date, slogan and URL compete for emphasis.
Glossy timber flecks, busy seam marks and isolated yellow edge wedges reduce local material refinement.

evidence.observation: In all three central-field members, explanation sits under title/slogan and leads into workshop/date/time/venue on the left and fee/deadline/invitation/URL on the right. residuals: Observed count is exactly five independent poster files, all included; the photographic triptych and illustrated vignettes are internal content, not a five-poster comparison sheet.

There are meaningful differences in photographic strip, tactile collage, painted shared table, sequential illustration and macro cropping, but M2/M3/M5 reuse a particularly similar spatial and information scaffold. Diversity is functional but short of the required 4.

The common route persists across most members: prominent title, Latin line, slogan, explanatory paragraph and paired event/application information. Material names alone do not establish whole-system independence.
Low scores and every style failure remain recorded; no mean, subset or replacement critic is used.
No source assets or protected-layout manifests are supplied, so source_fidelity arrays are explicitly empty. The review cannot establish undeclared source identity or unobserved production history.
This is one craft critic's assessment of these exact selected pixels; it does not establish the three-critic aggregate or transfer quality.
